title: C Development Environment
goal: GCC toolchain chalana, compile flags samajhna, compile aur linker errors padh kar fix karna.
definition: Development environment wo toolchain hai jo source ko executable banata hai: editor (VS Code), compiler (GCC/Clang), assembler, linker, debugger (GDB) aur build automation (Make).
explain: C khud kuch nahi chalata — compiler chahiye. Linux/macOS par GCC/Clang; Windows par MSYS2/MinGW-w64 ya WSL sabse aasan rasta hai.
VS Code sirf editor hai, compiler nahi. C/C++ extension IntelliSense aur debug UI deta hai; asli compile gcc command karti hai.
gcc hello.c -o hello ka matlab: compile karo aur output ka naam hello rakho. -std=c17 standard fix karta hai, -Wall -Wextra warnings on karte hain.
Error me pehla line sabse important hota hai — baad ke errors often usi ke consequence hote hain. Line number aur column dhyan se dekho.
analogy: Compiler translator hai: aap C me likhte ho, machine apni bhasha samajhti hai. Grammar galat hui to translator line number ke saath reject karta hai.
why: Beginners ka 90% time environment me jaata hai: gcc nahi mila, file save nahi hui, path galat. Ye module us friction ko khatam karta hai.

syntax.note: C17 + warnings ke saath compile, phir binary chalao. ./ Linux/macOS par zaroori hai.

syntax.code:
gcc -E hello.c -o hello.i   # preprocess
gcc -S hello.c -o hello.s   # assembly
gcc -c hello.c -o hello.o   # object
gcc hello.o -o hello        # link
syntax.note: Har stage alag dekh sakte ho.
Debug symbols + ASan/UBSan: memory bugs aur UB turant pakadte hain.

topics.title: GCC/Clang install
topics.body: Ubuntu: sudo apt install build-essential. macOS: xcode-select --install. Windows: MSYS2 (pacman -S mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc) ya WSL2. Clang commands lagbhag same hain.

topics.title: Editor setup
topics.body: VS Code + C/C++ extension, auto-save on, tasks.json me build task. File save kiye bina compile karna #1 beginner galti hai.

topics.title: Preprocessing
topics.body: #include file paste karta hai, #define text replace karta hai, #ifdef blocks include/exclude karta hai. Is stage par C syntax check nahi hota.

topics.title: Compile, assemble, link
topics.body: Compiler C → assembly; assembler assembly → object (.o); linker objects + libraries → executable. 'undefined reference' linker ka error hai, compiler ka nahi.

topics.title: Warnings aur debug cycle
topics.body: -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic on rakho; -Werror warnings ko error banata hai. GDB ke liye -g; sanitizers development me on rakho. Ek baar me ek change karo.

mcqs.explain: -c compile + assemble karta hai, link nahi.
Linker symbol resolve nahi kar paata.

interview.q: Preprocessor compiler se alag kaise hai?
interview.a: Preprocessor text-level kaam karta hai: includes paste, macros replace, conditional blocks. Uske baad compiler grammar parse karta hai.
interview.followUp: Kaunsa flag sirf preprocess karta hai? — -E.

interview.q: Object file aur executable me fark?
interview.a: Object me compiled code + unresolved symbols ho sakte hain; executable me linker ne sab resolve kar diya hota hai.
interview.followUp: Static library kya hai? — .o files ka archive (.a).

interview.a: Out-of-bounds, use-after-free, double free, leaks — detailed runtime report ke saath.
interview.followUp: UBSan? — signed overflow, invalid shift jaise UB.
